question: Is Wan2.2-TI2V-5B a necessary dependency of the official FasterWAM configuration, and is it a full checkpoint?

answer.component_role: visual backbone assets: WanVideoDiT (video expert weights) + Wan2.2 VAE; text encoder optional
answer.explanation: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B provides Wan components. The FasterWAM policy weights come from the official base_step_021700.pt (mot video+action experts + proprio encoder). Loader evidence: fasterwam/models/wan22/helpers/loader.py requires Wan2.2_VAE.pth from model_id; video DiT can be taken from the official mot (skip_dit_load_from_pretrain=true); text encoder is skipped with load_text_encoder=false because context is precomputed.

verified_files.sha256_verified: all weights match HF LFS sha256 (3 diffusion shards, Wan2.2_VAE.pth, text encoder, config/index)
